mapper.sql: a.id as id, a.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.title as orderTitle, o.amount as orderAmount, o.owner_id as ownerId, a.type as type, a.payload as payload, a.reason as reason, a.status as status, a.requester_id as requesterId, a.requester_name as requesterName, a.create_time as createTime, a.handler_name as handlerName, a.handle_note as handleNote, a.handle_time as handleTime
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_approval (order_id, type, payload, reason, status, requester_id, requester_name, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterName}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from jiedan_approval where order_id = #{orderId} and type = #{type} and status = 'pending'
mapper.update: update jiedan_approval set status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handler_name = #{handlerName}, handle_note = #{note}, handle_time = #{time} where id = #{id} and status = 'pending'
